desc: Warm, amused, entirely unembarrassed. A teacher pleased to have been found.
text: You found me. Took you long enough.

desc: Brisk and practical, listing things off, then one quiet direct question at the end.
text: Heart rate. Breath. Temperature. Water. Distance. I'm asking one question. Can we keep going safely?

desc: Kind, completely without apology. He knows he is right and he is not smug about it.
text: My best judgement. I'm not trying to stop you. I'm trying to get you to the finish line.

desc: Quiet, deciding. A small generous choice made out loud.
text: All right. Everything's holding. Let's give him a little more.

desc: Flat, resigned, end of a shift. Not frightened, just done.
